acceptanceCriteria: Impact uncertainty for non-Go repositories names the relevant language or a neutral profile, with tests for at least Swift, Kotlin and TypeScript fixtures.
body: Found during the Beamfall Corvint setup rollout (2026-10-20, corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676). `corvint impact AGENTS.md` in beamfall-apple, -android, -web and -docs reports reverse-import results as outside the native Go impact profile. The wording should name the actual language/profile (or be language-neutral). Related, narrower: V1-1814 (Ruby autoload).
title: impact uncertainty says 'outside the native Go impact profile' in Swift, Kotlin, TypeScript and docs-only repositories
